scenarios.name: Successful password reset using email link
steps: Given a registered user with email "user@example.com"
When the user requests a password reset
Then an email with a reset link is sent to "user@example.com"
When the user clicks the link within 30 minutes
And provides a new password "NewPass123!"
Then the password is updated and the user can log in with the new password

scenarios.name: Reset link expires after 30 minutes
steps: Given a password reset email was sent to "user@example.com" at time T0
When the user clicks the link at time T0 plus 30 minutes and 1 second
Then the system shows an "link expired" error and does not allow password change

scenarios.name: Reset link can be used only once
steps: Given a password reset email was sent to "user@example.com"
When the user clicks the link and sets a new password
Then the password is changed successfully
When the same link is clicked again
Then the system shows an "invalid or used link" error

scenarios.name: Request reset with unregistered email
steps: Given an email address "unknown@example.com" that is not associated with any account
When the user requests a password reset for that email
Then the system responds with a generic message indicating that if the email exists, instructions have been sent
And no email is actually sent to "unknown@example.com"

scenarios.name: Multiple reset requests and one-time link usage
steps: Given a registered user requests a password reset and receives link A
And the same user requests another password reset and receives link B
When the user uses link A to set a new password
Then the password is updated and link A becomes invalid
When the user later uses link B within 30 minutes
Then the password is updated again and link B becomes invalid

pytest_cases.intent: verify successful reset with valid link within expiry
ensure link is rejected after 30 minutes
validate multiple links and one‑time usage

coverage_notes: Reviewer should verify email delivery mock/stub, time‑travel handling for expiration, that generic responses do not disclose account existence, rate‑limit on reset requests, secure token generation, and that UI messages match expectations.
